sources: https://www.brevardfl.gov/ParksAndRecreation/Campgrounds/ManateeHammockPark (read in a browser, incl. its Camping, Rates and Rules tabs)

values.note: Brevard County residents pay the $31.80 daily camping rate plus the $2/day sewer site fee that every RV site here carries (all 163 have sewer): $33.80. Non-residents $45.03, or $47.35 November 1 - April 30, plus the same $2. The 4 water-view sites add $2/day. Before 7% sales and 5% tourist tax. Tent-only sites (water/electric, no sewer) are $31.80 resident.

fees.source: https://www.brevardfl.gov/ParksAndRecreation/Campgrounds/ManateeHammockPark Rates tab ('Brevard County Resident Daily Camping Rates ... Manatee Hammock $31.80 $31.80', 'Non-Resident ... Manatee Hammock $45.03 $47.35', 'Water Access/Water View $2.00 daily, Sewage Site Fee (Campers) $2.00 daily') + Rules tab ('Premium Site Fees: Applies to ... any of the 4 sites at Manatee Hammock with a water view, or any site at all 3 campgrounds that include sewer access. This fee applies to residents and non-residents equally') + Camping tab ('163 RV sites with water, electric and sewer'), read 2026-10-21

hookups.source: https://www.brevardfl.gov/ParksAndRecreation/Campgrounds/ManateeHammockPark Camping tab ('163 RV sites with water, electric and sewer'), read 2026-10-21; amperage not stated

values.note: 163 full-hookup RV sites and 19 tent-only sites with water and electric, plus a group tent area by permit; 4 sites have a water view.

sites.source: https://www.brevardfl.gov/ParksAndRecreation/Campgrounds/ManateeHammockPark ('163 RV sites (full hookup), 19 tent sites (water, electric), group tent camping area by special permit'), read 2026-10-21

facilities.source: https://www.brevardfl.gov/ParksAndRecreation/Campgrounds/ManateeHammockPark ('campground has laundry facilities, hot showers and camp store'; Camping tab 'Hot showers, Laundry facilities, Swimming pool for campers, Pavilion, Wi-Fi'), read 2026-10-21

values.note: Brevard County's own WebTrac booking site, or in person, by email or phone (321-264-5083). Brevard County residents may book 395 days (13 months) ahead, non-residents 180 days (6 months). RVs up to 90 days per reservation (tents 14). Check-in 2-9 pm, check-out 11 am.

booking.source: https://www.brevardfl.gov/ParksAndRecreation/Campgrounds/ManateeHammockPark ('Book a Campground' -> registration.brevardfl.gov/webtrac; 'Brevard County residents can reserve up to 395 days (13 months) in advance, while non-residents can book up to 180 days (6 months) in advance'; 'The maximum length of stay for RVs and camping units is 90 days per reservation and for tent campers, 14 days'; 'The minimum length of stay is one night'), read 2026-10-21

summary: County page: added resident $33.80 (the $31.80 rate plus the $2 sewer fee every RV site carries), non-resident +$13.23 ($47.03; $49.35 Nov-Apr incl. sewer fee), $2 water-view premium, water/sewer hookups, 163 RV + 19 tent sites, showers/laundry/camp store/Wi-Fi, WebTrac booking with 395-day resident window and 90-day max. Phone 321-264-5083 confirmed. Not stated: amperage, site lengths, season. No Hurricane Isaias closure posted. AWH note kept.
